notes: Default manifest only. The run-time split is whatever manifest the launcher was given; this one is the checked-in default/example.
Deployment == the complete compiled valid_unseen set (134 games), ALFWorld's standard out-of-distribution evaluation set.
Task ids are trial paths relative to json_2.1.1/, so a user can write a split by hand without consulting any other file.

role_map.deployment: native json_2.1.1/valid_unseen -- out-of-distribution (the full 134-game standard eval set)

official_scorer.note: success is decided by the simulator, not by a scoring function; no scorer is implemented in this workspace.
